description: This file defines the EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule class, which implements a validation rule to check if a user has read permission for a specific data group within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. The class interacts with role management traits and throws a ForbiddenException if access is denied.

classes.name: EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if the current user has permission to read a specified data group.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the specified data group name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check to determine if the user has read access to the data group; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.
